the node integrated toward the horizon by the kernel's Taylor stepper, to u₀/32
each rung: Newton on the 2M horizon unknowns (m_h, a_h) in the m and a rows, from the last rung's data
at u₀ the solve is polished in quad-double (residual_q, a QDLu solve) down to its floor
